summary: A 54-foot metal lookout on the White Mountains' Greens Peak, built in 1962 to replace a 1933 Aermotor tower; registered on the NHLR in 2002.

facts.design: 54-ft metal tower with a 14 x 14 CL 100 live-in cab with catwalk (built 1962), replacing a 1933 Aermotor MC24 lookout

access.note: Reached by high-clearance 4WD up FR 61C, or about 2 miles on foot from FR 117. No source read confirms whether the tower itself is open to visitors.

visit.trail_note: FR 117 north from State Route 260 near Pole Knoll Recreation Area, then FR 61 to FR 61C; about 2 miles on foot from FR 117 per Arizona Highways

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives the lookout site as 10,099 ft (3,078 m), Arizona Highways gives the summit as 10,134 ft, and PeakBagging gives 10,135 ft. The record keeps the register's 10,099 ft (3,078 m) figure, since it is for the lookout site.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing and any notable fire history are unconfirmed; no source read covers either. Access is a judgment: the road and hike approach are documented, but tower entry is not confirmed, so the level is set to restricted. The 1933 build date and the 54-ft height agree across the register and PeakBagging, but PeakBagging spells the maker Aeromotor where the register says Aermotor. The West Lookouts Greens Peak entry has no event text, only the registry header, so it is not cited. Read budget was exceeded (about 6 page reads plus repeat fetches).
